		AND CUST.BANK_ID = ATM_CLIENT.BNK_CODE
		AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE) BETWEEN ATM_CLIENT.SCD_Start_Date
			AND ATM_CLIENT.SCD_End_Date
	LEFT JOIN EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB AS MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB ON CUST.ORGKEY = MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.CIF_NO
		AND CUST.BANK_ID = MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.BNK_CODE
		AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE) BETWEEN MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_Start_Date
			AND MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB.SCD_End_Date
	LEFT JOIN EDS.RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION AS RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION ON CUST.ORGKEY = RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.CUST_ID
		AND CUST.BANK_ID = RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.BNK_CODE
		AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE) BETWEEN RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.SCD_Start_Date
			AND RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION.SCD_End_Date
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT *
		FROM (
			SELECT row_number() OVER (
					PARTITION BY orgkey ORDER BY miscellaneousid DESC
					) AS rn
				,*
			FROM eds.crm_miscellaneousinfo
			WHERE type = 'PRIVACY_NOTICE'
				--AND CORE_CUST_ID IS NOT NULL
				AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE) BETWEEN scd_start_date
					AND scd_end_date
			) a
		WHERE rn = 1
		) AS CONSENT ON
		--CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = CONSENT.CORE_CUST_ID AND 
		CUST.ORGKEY = CONSENT.ORGKEY
		AND CUST.BANK_ID = CONSENT.BANK_ID
		AND LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY, 1) IN (
			'R'
			,'P'
			)
	LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY_DIM AS MV_CITY ON MV_CITY.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.CITY
		AND MV_CITY.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
		AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_CITY.SCD_Start_Date
			AND MV_CITY.SCD_End_Date
	LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM AS MV_STATE ON MV_STATE.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.[STATE]
		AND MV_STATE.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
		AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_STATE.SCD_Start_Date
			AND MV_STATE.SCD_End_Date
	LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_COUNTRY_DIM AS MV_COUNTRY ON MV_COUNTRY.[VALUE] = ADDRESS.[STATE]
		AND MV_COUNTRY.BANK_ID = ADDRESS.BANK_ID
		AND CAST(@process_date AS DATE) BETWEEN MV_COUNTRY.SCD_Start_Date
			AND MV_COUNTRY.SCD_End_Date
	LEFT JOIN (
		SELECT EDA.CUST_ID
			,EDA.BANK_ID
		FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
		INNER JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
			AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
			AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		INNER JOIN EDS.BOB_TBLACCOUNT EBT ON EBT.NO = EDF.FORACID
			AND EBT.BNK_CODE = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
			AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBT.SCD_START_DATE
				AND EBT.SCD_END_DATE
		WHERE @process_date = EDA.AS_OF_DATE
		
		UNION
		
		SELECT EDA.CUST_ID
			,EDA.BANK_ID
		FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN EDA
		INNER JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT EDF ON EDA.ACID = EDF.GAM_ACID
			AND EDA.BANK_ID = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
			AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDF.AS_OF_DATE
		INNER JOIN EDS.BOB_TBLACCOUNT EBT ON EBT.NO = EDF.FORACID
			AND EBT.BNK_CODE = EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
			AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN EBT.SCD_START_DATE
				AND EBT.SCD_END_DATE
		WHERE @process_date = EDA.AS_OF_DATE
		) BOB_LKP ON BOB_LKP.CUST_ID = CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
		AND BOB_LKP.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID
	WHERE CUST.H = 'D';
